extension.name: NYSS: Caseload Dashboard
extension.description: Implements a caseload dashboard that gives Case Coordinators a real- time, consolidated view of caseload health across their district, enabling them to monitor workload distribution, identify cases at risk of being neglected or aging out, and ensure every case has an assigned Case Manager.

compatibility.comments: Semantic versioning. For example, compatibility with "6.1" implies compatibility with "6.2".

php_compatibility.comments: Listed versions. For example, specify both "8.1" and "8.2".

smarty_compatibility.comments: Listed versions. For example, specify both "4" and "5".

extension.comments: This is a new, undeveloped module
